reason: Comparing written offers sounds useful, but I'm paying from abroad and the real problem is knowing the company actually installs what they quoted. For now I'll keep asking in the Facebook group and have my cousin get two quotes locally, which costs me nothing either.
objection: From abroad I can't check that the company actually did the work. A rating after the job doesn't help me if my money is already gone and the batteries they put in aren't the ones on the quote.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of the finished job sent to me before final payment, like photos or video of the installed panels, battery and inverter labels matched against the quote, or someone independent confirming it on site.
